subject: Request: contingency headcount exception & redeployment plan for Platform SLO coverage
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Urgent: contingency headcount exception request for Platform SLO coverage

Team —

Heads-up: we had a resignation on Platform yesterday (senior SWE, IC4) that drops our planned on-call capacity at a bad time for the H2 rollout. I know we’re under the freeze but this is a narrow production risk window tied to the new routing rollout and a performance-sensitive customer cohort.

Options I see (ranked):
1) 3-month contractor extension (immediately) + recruit for permanent backfill in Q1 (fast, moderate cost)
2) Temporary HC exception for a 6-month fixed-term hire (faster than full req)
3) Cross-team redeployment: move one mid-SWE from Insights to Platform and backfill Insights later (low cost, higher org disruption)

I've attached an initial SLO impact estimate and a short redeployment plan. This situation is partially sensitive because the outgoing person is on a short notice tied to a competing offer; please avoid copying them or mentioning specifics outside core leadership / People Ops.

Requesting: sign-off on option 1 as an interim measure and permission to start the FinOps/People Ops approval flow today. If leadership prefers a different route, please say so with a brief reason.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Production Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: HC_exception_form.pdf (pdf), slo-impact-estimate.xlsx (xlsx), redeployment-plan-v1.docx (docx)

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 11:01:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: contingency headcount exception request for Platform SLO coverage

On Fri, Nov 13, 2026 at 09:12 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Heads-up: we had a resignation on Platform yesterday ...

Vivek / Laura —

Thanks for the quick heads-up. I reviewed the attached SLO estimate and redeployment plan. My recommendation: approve option 1 (3-month contractor extension + Q1 permanent hire cadence) with the following guardrails:
- Cap contractor spend to $45k/month; require weekly status updates to Platform leads.
- HR to flag the req as "sensitive backfill" so we don't surface it in the public hiring pipeline until we confirm permanent plan.
- If the contractor is not onboarded within 7 business days, we proceed to redeploy one mid-SWE from Insights (option 3) — that gives us a clear escalation path.

Cost delta is ~ $135k for three months vs an immediate FT hire. FinOps wants the explicit approval to charge contingency spend to project code PROJ-PLTF-H2.

I will route the signed HC exception form to People Ops and loop in Emma from FinOps for the budget sign-off. Please keep comms tight per Vivek’s note.

Aisha Rahman
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: HC_exception_form.pdf (filled draft)

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, hr-approvals@peopleops.com
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 14:23:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: contingency headcount exception request for Platform SLO coverage

Aisha / Vivek —

Thanks, I approve option 1 with the guardrails Aisha listed. Two quick asks before we route to People Ops for formal sign-off:
1) Add explicit acceptance criteria in the redeployment doc for returning the Insights SWE within 12 weeks if redeployed (minimize long-term churn).
2) Emma (FinOps) should confirm budget code; I’m copying hr-approvals so they can advise on timeline for an exception under current freeze policy.

Once People Ops confirms, we’ll treat this as a leadership-approved exception and post a private note in the hiring tracker (DO NOT publish to public JD).

Laura Bennett
Head of Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

--
Laura Bennett
Redwood Inference

From: People Ops Approvals <hr-approvals@peopleops.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: Request: contingency headcount exception & redeployment plan for Platform SLO coverage

Hi Aisha/Laura/Vivek —

Thanks for the details and the completed HC exception form. People Ops confirms we can process a 3-month contractor exception under the current hiring freeze provided: 
- Leadership approval is captured in writing (this email chain suffices).
- FinOps confirms available spend on PROJ-PLTF-H2 (please cc emma@finops-partner.com).
- Contractor agreement signed and contractor onboarding checklist completed within 10 business days.

Please attach a redacted version of the redeployment plan (remove PII and the departing employee’s name) when you submit to the exceptions queue. We will queue this for expedited review and, if approved, issue the exception token and route to procurement for the SOW.

Checklist: HC_exception_form.pdf (received), redeployment-plan-v1.docx (please redact), slo-impact-estimate.xlsx (received)

Regards,
People Ops Approvals Team
hr-approvals@peopleops.com

Attachment: exception-queue-link: https://peopleops.redwood.com/exceptions/queue/EX-9982
